title: Check Point: 2,830 victims published on ransomware leak sites in Q3 2026, the highest quarter on record
date_note: Publication day of Check Point's Q3 2026 report; the report covers the third quarter.
geo_basis: Check Point's headquarters region; the report is worldwide
summary: Check Point Research says Q3 2026 was the highest-volume quarter on record, with 2,830 victims published on data leak sites. Help Net Security's 24 November write-up relays the report under the headline that ransomware gangs keep multiplying even as fewer victims pay.
plain: Check Point says ransomware gangs posted 2,830 victims on leak sites in the third quarter of 2026, the most in any quarter it has recorded.
exec: Check Point's count shows ransomware leak-site postings at a record 2,830 victims in one quarter.

sources.name: Check Point Research - The State of Ransomware Q3 2026

evidence.quote: Q3 2026 was the highest-volume quarter on record, with 2,830 victims published on data leak sites.

validation.note: Check Point's own report page is the primary source; Help Net Security relays the same figure.
